name: Robert's Ship
description: A turn-of-the-century polar expedition ship drawn in 2D flat vector style — a stout wooden vessel with a distinctive rounded, egg-shaped reinforced hull painted dark blackish-brown, built to ride up over crushing sea ice. Three tall masts with furled canvas sails plus a single black steam smokestack amidships puffing grey smoke, a raised wooden bow. Sturdy and heavy-looking. Solid flat color fills, bold black outline around the entire silhouette.

name: The Miranda
description: An older, worn wooden steamer-barque drawn in 2D flat vector style — a weathered dark-hulled sailing ship with two masts, patched canvas sails, a thin black smokestack, and a visibly aged, ill-fated look with scuffed and stained planking. Smaller and shabbier than Robert's Ship. Solid flat color fills, bold black outline around the entire silhouette.

name: The Brass Sextant
description: A late-1800s French-made brass sextant navigation instrument drawn in 2D flat vector style — a polished golden-brass triangular frame with a graduated arc scale along the bottom, a small sighting telescope, and mirrors. Compact handheld precision instrument, warm brass tones with flat matte (non-shiny) fills. Bold black outline around the entire silhouette.

name: The Three Crates
description: Three large wooden shipping crates drawn in 2D flat vector style — sturdy pale-wood packing boxes with visible plank seams and dark iron corner brackets, bound with rope, of slightly different sizes stacked or set side by side. Weathered but solid. Solid flat color fills, bold black outlines on each crate.

name: The Iron Meteorite
description: A colossal dark iron meteorite drawn in 2D flat vector style — a massive rounded lump of blackish-grey iron with a rough, pitted, uneven surface and dull metallic sheen rendered as flat matte color (no shine or glow). Far larger than a person, brutally heavy-looking. Bold black outline around the entire silhouette.

name: The Expedition Flag
description: A hand-sewn American flag drawn in 2D flat vector style — stars and stripes in flat red, white and blue, mounted on a simple dark wooden pole, the cloth stitched and slightly worn as if homemade. Rendered flat with bold outlines, catching the wind. Bold black outline around the entire silhouette.

name: The Wooden Sledge
description: A traditional Arctic dog sledge drawn in 2D flat vector style — a long low sledge built from lashed wooden slats and curved runners, tied with rope and loaded with fur bundles, wooden boxes and coiled line. Rugged, functional, warm brown wood tones. Solid flat color fills, bold black outline around the entire silhouette.

name: The Newspaper
description: An early-1900s front-page newspaper broadsheet drawn in 2D flat vector style — a large folded sheet of pale off-white newsprint with a bold masthead band, blocky columns, and a grainy illustration, but with NO legible readable headline text (only abstract grey blocks and lines standing in for type, since real headlines will be added in post-production). Slightly creased. Solid flat color fills, bold black outline.

name: The Folding Boat
description: A small collapsible folding boat drawn in 2D flat vector style — a lightweight canvas-and-wood-frame dinghy in tan and grey, narrow and shallow, the kind a single man could carry, with a simple wooden paddle. Practical and worn. Solid flat color fills, bold black outline around the entire silhouette.
